commands.label: init-help
commands.stdout:
usage: harnessctl init [-h] [--project-name PROJECT_NAME] [--dry-run] [--json]
                       [target]

positional arguments:
  target

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project-name PROJECT_NAME
  --dry-run             report the complete plan without writing
  --json                emit one se-harness-command-result-v1 object

commands.label: check-help
commands.stdout:
usage: harnessctl check [-h] [--artifact ARTIFACT]
                        [--checkpoint {start,pre-action,transition,handoff,scope}]
                        [--include-background] [--target TARGET_STATE]
                        [--procedure PROCEDURE] [--changed-path CHANGED_PATH]
                        [--changes-complete]
                        [--change-manifest CHANGE_MANIFEST] [--from-git BASE]
                        [--pull-request-body PULL_REQUEST_BODY] [--json]
                        [target]

positional arguments:
  target

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --artifact ARTIFACT   one selected WO, VREC, or RLS ID; without a checkpoint
                        it defaults to the single in_progress work order
  --checkpoint {start,pre-action,transition,handoff,scope}
                        fixed stateless evaluation checkpoint; omitted, check
                        projects the selected scope and evaluates no gate
  --include-background  with no checkpoint, list unrelated findings by
                        category instead of one count
  --target TARGET_STATE
                        target lifecycle state; required for and limited to
                        the transition checkpoint
  --procedure PROCEDURE
                        selected PROC ID; required for pre-action and limited
                        to declared alternatives
  --changed-path CHANGED_PATH
                        normalized repository-relative changed path; repeat
                        for the declared set
  --changes-complete    assert that repeated changed paths are complete; this
                        is evidence, not trusted proof
  --change-manifest CHANGE_MANIFEST
                        in-repository se-harness-change-set-v1 JSON; exclusive
                        with changed-path options
  --from-git BASE       derive the complete change set from Git against BASE;
                        exclusive with the changed-path options
  --pull-request-body PULL_REQUEST_BODY
                        UTF-8 pull-request body file; reports W-ADS-001 when
                        its work-order trailer carries a carriage return
  --json                emit se-harness-workflow-result-v2 JSON

commands.label: evidence-help
commands.stdout:
usage: harnessctl evidence [-h] --artifact ARTIFACT --checkpoint
                           {start,pre-action,transition,handoff}
                           [--rebound-at REBOUND_AT] [--json]
                           [target]

positional arguments:
  target

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --artifact ARTIFACT   the work order the packet is keyed by
  --checkpoint {start,pre-action,transition,handoff}
  --rebound-at REBOUND_AT
                        RFC 3339 UTC timestamp to record; defaults to now
  --json                emit se-harness-workflow-result-v2 JSON

commands.label: capture-verification-help
commands.stdout:
usage: harnessctl capture-verification [-h] --id RECORD_ID --work-order
                                       WORK_ORDER --verification VERIFICATION
                                       --evidence EVIDENCE [--owner OWNER]
                                       [--output OUTPUT] [--domain DOMAIN]
                                       [--json]
                                       [target]

positional arguments:
  target

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --id RECORD_ID
  --work-order WORK_ORDER
                        work order to verify; repeat for aggregate candidates
  --verification VERIFICATION
                        applicable verification contract; repeat for aggregate
                        candidates
  --evidence EVIDENCE   retained evidence path; repeat for aggregate
                        candidates
  --owner OWNER         preparation actor and record owner; does not verify
                        the record
  --output OUTPUT
  --domain DOMAIN       place the record in an explicit engineering domain
  --json                emit the canonical workflow result as JSON

commands.label: prepare-release-help
commands.stdout:
usage: harnessctl prepare-release [-h] --id RECORD_ID --release-contract
                                  RELEASE_CONTRACT --verification-record
                                  VERIFICATION_RECORD --work-order WORK_ORDER
                                  --version RELEASE_VERSION --owner OWNER
                                  [--tag TAG] [--output OUTPUT]
                                  [--domain DOMAIN] [--json]
                                  [target]

positional arguments:
  target

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --id RECORD_ID
  --release-contract RELEASE_CONTRACT
  --verification-record VERIFICATION_RECORD
                        included verification record; repeat for aggregate
                        releases
  --work-order WORK_ORDER
                        released work order; repeat for aggregate releases
  --version RELEASE_VERSION
  --owner OWNER         preparation actor and record owner; does not authorize
                        the release
  --tag TAG
  --output OUTPUT
  --domain DOMAIN       place the record in an explicit engineering domain
  --json                emit the canonical workflow result as JSON

commands.label: transition-help
commands.stdout:
usage: harnessctl transition [-h] --set TRANSITIONS --decision DECISIONS
                             [--reason REASONS] [--apply] [--json]
                             [target]

positional arguments:
  target

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --set TRANSITIONS     explicit ID=STATUS transition; repeat for packets
  --decision DECISIONS  ID=ACTOR assertion; repeat for every selected artifact
  --reason REASONS      ID=TEXT reason; required for rejection, or use
                        successor VREC ID for supersession
  --apply               apply the exact validated transaction; default is
                        read-only planning
  --json
